title: AI Content Generation & WordPress Publishing Platform
summary: A production-grade SaaS platform combining multi-agent AI systems, WordPress automation, and SEO optimisation using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI GPT-4.
description:
Project Overview

A sophisticated SaaS platform that combines AI-powered content generation, WordPress publishing automation, and SEO optimisation. The platform uses multi-agent AI systems built with LangChain and LangGraph to research, write, and optimise blog content while leveraging real search data from Google Search Console.

AI & LLM Integration

  • Built a multi-agent AI system with LangGraph featuring 9 specialised research tools including Google Search Console integration, website crawling, competitor analysis, and vector-based knowledge retrieval.
  • Implemented RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) using PostgreSQL with pgvector extension for semantic search across crawled website content, enabling context-aware article generation with automatic internal linking.
  • Integrated Google Search Console API with OAuth 2.0 to leverage real search performance data, content gap analysis (high impressions, low clicks), and trending queries with 7-day caching optimisation.
  • Developed an intelligent website crawler that extracts and classifies content (products, services, pages), brand information (colours, logos, tagline), and generates vector embeddings for context-aware article generation.

Full-Stack Architecture

  • React/TypeScript frontend with Mantine UI for bot management, content generation dashboard, and lead management.
  • Node.js/Express backend with Sequelize ORM, Redis session management, multi-tenant architecture, and isolated knowledge bases per bot.
  • Custom WordPress plugin (PHP) enabling one-click publishing with automatic category/tag creation, metadata synchronisation (Yoast/Rank Math compatible), and featured image handling.

Key Features

  • Automated blog generation with SEO optimisation, keyword density management (1-2%), and meta description generation (155 chars).
  • Content ideas pipeline from multiple sources (GSC content gaps, competitor analysis, RSS feeds, website context).
  • WordPress REST API integration for seamless publishing and metadata synchronisation.

title: AI-Powered Lead Generation Chatbot Platform
summary: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for creating RAG-powered chatbots with dynamic lead capture, PDF knowledge bases, and automated email notifications.
description:
Project Overview

A comprehensive multi-tenant chatbot platform that combines RAG-powered conversational AI with intelligent lead capture. Built for businesses to deploy custom chatbots on their websites with knowledge bases from uploaded PDFs and automated lead generation workflows.

AI & RAG Implementation

  • Implemented RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system using LangChain with FAISS vector store and OpenAI embeddings (text-embedding-ada-002) for context-aware responses from PDF knowledge bases.
  • Built LangChain agents with OpenAI GPT-4o for natural conversations with hallucination prevention through semantic search and context retrieval.
  • Created dynamic tool generation system using Zod schemas and LangChain's DynamicStructuredTool, allowing chatbots to intelligently capture structured lead data based on customizable schemas.
  • Engineered PDF processing pipeline with text extraction (pdf-parse), chunking using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (1000 char chunks, 200 overlap), and embedding generation with vector store persistence.

Platform Features

  • Multi-tenant architecture with isolated knowledge bases, secure bot management, and API key-based authentication for each bot.
  • Session-based conversation memory with chat history persistence in PostgreSQL, maintaining context across multiple interactions.
  • Automatic email notifications via Nodemailer with formatted lead details, chat transcripts, and customizable SMTP configuration per bot.
  • React/TypeScript admin dashboard for bot creation, knowledge base updates (PDF upload/replacement), lead management, and analytics.
  • WordPress widget integration with CORS-enabled public API for easy deployment on client websites.

Technical Highlights

  • Migrated backend from Flask/Python to Express.js/TypeScript with full feature parity, improved performance, and enhanced type safety.
  • User authentication with Passport.js, session management with express-session, and secure API key generation with bcrypt hashing.
  • Vector store persistence with automatic loading and caching for improved performance (avoiding recreation on every request).

title: Full-Stack Portfolio & CI/CD Pipeline
summary: A full-stack portfolio website featuring a complete CI/CD pipeline for automated builds and deployments to a cloud server.
description:
Project Overview

This portfolio is a full-stack application built from the ground up to serve as a dynamic showcase of my work. More than just a frontend, it features a complete DevOps pipeline that automates the entire process from a `git push` to a live deployment on a cloud server, demonstrating a holistic approach to modern web development.

Full-Stack Architecture

  • The frontend is a responsive single-page application built with React and Vite, using the Mantine component library for a clean and modern UI.
  • The backend is a lightweight Node.js and Express server that serves the static React files and provides a REST API for dynamic content like project data and skills.

CI/CD & DevOps Pipeline

  • The entire application is containerised using a multi-stage Dockerfile, which builds the frontend and bundles it with the backend into a single, optimised image.
  • A GitHub Actions workflow automatically triggers on every push to the `main` branch.
  • The workflow builds the Docker image, pushes it to Docker Hub, and then securely connects to an AWS Lightsail instance via SSH.
  • On the server, Docker Compose pulls the new image and seamlessly redeploys the container, ensuring zero downtime.

title: Kiwi Kandy - WooCommerce E-commerce Platform
summary: A complete e-commerce platform selling classic New Zealand confectionery worldwide, featuring Google Merchant Center integration and automated order fulfillment.
description:
Project Overview

A full-scale e-commerce website built for KiwiKandy, dedicated to selling iconic New Zealand confectionery to customers living overseas. This project demonstrates comprehensive e-commerce management, payment processing, and international shipping logistics.

E-commerce Features

  • Built on WordPress with WooCommerce to manage complete online sales operations including inventory management, order processing, and customer accounts.
  • Google Merchant Center integration for automated product feed generation, enabling product listings across Google Shopping with automated inventory synchronization.
  • Configured complex international shipping zones and rates to handle global deliveries with accurate cost calculations based on weight and destination.
  • Integrated secure payment gateways including Stripe for safe and reliable transactions with PCI compliance.

Platform Management

  • Designed user-friendly product catalogue with advanced filtering, search functionality, and category organization for easy navigation.
  • Implemented automated order fulfillment workflows including shipping label generation, inventory tracking, and customer notification systems.
  • Custom product configurations for gift boxes and variety packs with dynamic pricing based on selections.

Business Impact

  • Established reliable platform for handling international payments and worldwide shipping logistics.
  • Created seamless shopping experience optimized for conversion with streamlined checkout process.

title: The Phone Mason - Local SEO & Lead Generation
summary: A business website for a device repair shop, achieving top 3 local search rankings through strategic SEO and continuous optimization.
description:
Project Overview

A comprehensive business website for The Phone Mason, a device repair specialist, designed to capture local market share through strategic SEO and lead generation optimization.

SEO Strategy & Implementation

  • Implemented robust local SEO strategy including Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, and location-based keyword targeting.
  • Performed extensive on-page optimization focused on relevant keywords, meta descriptions, header tags, and semantic HTML structure.
  • Continuous SEO monitoring and refinement using Google Analytics and Ahrefs for keyword tracking, backlink analysis, and competitor research.
  • Created targeted ad campaigns with optimized landing pages for specific repair services (screen repair, battery replacement, water damage).

Technical Implementation

  • Led end-to-end development and deployment of WordPress website with custom theme modifications and plugin integration.
  • Deployed on AWS with optimized server configuration for fast loading times and reliable uptime.
  • Implemented conversion optimization with strategic call-to-action placement, contact forms, and click-to-call functionality.

Results

  • Achieved top 3 local search rankings for competitive repair keywords in the Howick, Auckland area.
  • Website successfully converts targeted traffic into valuable customer leads, creating a reliable growth engine for the business.

title: AI Content Generator with Gemini Pro
summary: A web application leveraging Google's Gemini Pro to help users generate high-quality, brand-aligned website content.
description:
Project Overview

An AI-powered content assistant designed to help bloggers, marketers, and website owners overcome writer's block and efficiently produce high-quality, relevant content. This project demonstrates integration with Google's Gemini Pro API for generative AI capabilities.

AI Technology

The application leverages the power of Google's Gemini Pro API to generate text that is coherent, context-aware, and tailored to the user's specific needs and brand voice.

Key Features

  • A clean and interactive user interface built with Streamlit for rapid prototyping and deployment.
  • Generates a variety of content types, including full-length blog posts, 'About Us' pages, product descriptions, and marketing copy.
  • Allows users to define a specific context or 'brand voice' to ensure all generated content is perfectly aligned with their business identity.
  • Real-time content generation with streaming responses for immediate feedback.

Use Cases

  • Blog post generation with SEO-friendly structure and keyword integration.
  • Marketing content creation for landing pages and promotional materials.
  • Content ideation and outline generation for content planning.

title: WEDO - Social Connection Mobile App
summary: A full-stack, cross-platform mobile application for iOS and Android using serverless AWS architecture to connect people through local events.
description:
Project Overview

A full-stack, cross-platform social connection app built for iOS and Android as part of a university capstone project. 'WeDo' helps users build meaningful connections by creating, discovering, and joining local events and activities.

Key Features

  • Personalised event recommendations powered by user interest profiles and location-based filtering.
  • Advanced event search with robust filtering options (date, location, category, price range).
  • Integrated personal calendar to easily track upcoming activities and manage RSVPs.
  • Full event creation and management functionality for users to host their own activities.
  • Real-time notifications for event updates, new attendees, and messages.

Technical Architecture

  • Cross-platform frontend built with React Native for consistent iOS and Android experience with a single codebase.
  • Scalable backend powered by Node.js and Express.js with RESTful API design.
  • Fully serverless architecture leveraging AWS services: Lambda (compute), API Gateway (routing), DynamoDB (database), S3 (image storage), and Cognito (authentication).
  • Cost-efficient, auto-scaling infrastructure that handles traffic spikes without manual intervention.

title: React Stopwatch
summary: A clean and functional stopwatch application built with React, demonstrating state management with hooks.
description:
Project Overview

A straightforward stopwatch application built to demonstrate a solid understanding of core React concepts, particularly state management with hooks like useState and useEffect.

Key Feature

The entire logic for starting, stopping, and resetting the timer is handled cleanly within a single, reusable component, highlighting a component-based approach to building interactive UIs.

title: React To-Do List
summary: A classic to-do list application demonstrating fundamental React concepts like state management and event handling.
description:
Project Overview

A classic to-do list application built as a practical exercise to demonstrate fundamental React skills in state management and component architecture.

Core Functionality

  • Add new tasks to the list with input validation.
  • Mark tasks as complete with visual indicators and strike-through styling.
  • Remove tasks from the list with delete functionality.
  • Persist task state during the session.

Technical Implementation

The application's state is managed efficiently with the useState hook. The UI is structured with reusable components for the input form and individual task items, demonstrating component composition principles.
